title: VisionBurst
description: A fun and lightweight Paper plugin that brings bursts of creativity and surprises to your Minecraft world.
body:
# ⚡ VisionBurst – Dynamic Vision Power Plugin

> VisionBurst is a lightweight and powerful Minecraft plugin that adds a new layer of visual excitement and player enhancement. Designed for fun and flexibility, it introduces burst-based vision effects, allowing players to activate powerful visual boosts during gameplay.

### 🌟 Features:

- Vision Bursts: Trigger special vision effects such as night vision, glowing, or custom particle bursts
- Customizable Settings: Easily adjust durations, cooldowns, and effect types through configuration files
- Command-Based Control: Simple commands for activating or disabling effects, perfect for both survival and event servers
- Permission Support: Fine-tuned access control for staff or ranked players

### 🎮 Why Use VisionBurst?
> Add excitement and energy to your world with customizable player effects that enhance gameplay, roleplay, or events. Perfect for servers that want a touch of magic and style without sacrificing performance.
